title: LLM Comparison Dashboard
description: Interactive Streamlit dashboard comparing 70+ LLMs (GPT, Llama, Deepseek, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, and more) from 8 providers across speed, latency, context window, benchmark scores (MMLU, Chatbot Arena), pricing, and energy efficiency — with a fully filterable, tab-based interface.

title: FraudScope
description: A fraud and anomaly detection tool for financial ledgers. Upload a CSV of transactions and it scans every row using statistical forensics (not an LLM guessing at numbers) to surface duplicates, threshold-skirting, timing anomalies, and other classic fraud signals — each with a plain-language explanation of why it was flagged.

title: Casefile — Resume Agent
description: Helps job seekers evaluate and improve their resumes against real job postings. Upload a resume once, paste any job description, and get an instant match score plus specific, actionable suggestions — then let the tool rearrange and reword your resume (using only your real experience) to better align with that role.

title: Student Grade & GPA Prediction
description: End-to-end ML pipeline on a student dataset — EDA, preprocessing, classification (92.5% accuracy) and regression (R² = 0.94) models, with SHAP explainability.

title: House Price Prediction
description: EDA and regression modeling on a house price dataset — comparing Linear, Ridge, Lasso, Random Forest, and tuned Gradient Boosting (R² = 0.91 after tuning).

title: Traffic Flow Prediction
description: Regression modeling to predict traffic flow from road type, day type, weather and time — Gradient Boosting achieved R² = 0.986.

title: Netflix Content Analysis (EDA)
description: Exploratory data analysis on Netflix's content catalog — content type trends, release patterns, and country-wise distribution.

title: Tic Tac Toe AI
description: A polished, interactive Tic Tac Toe game built with Python and Streamlit, featuring a smart unbeatable Minimax AI opponent, adjustable difficulty levels, and a sleek dark-themed UI.

title: Scanline
description: A browser-based QR code generator with custom colors and logo embedding. Runs entirely client-side, no backend required.

title: Smart Community Safety App
description: A Flutter-based mobile app (academic semester project) promoting community safety through incident reporting, an interactive unsafe-zone map, community alerts, an SOS emergency mode, and an analytics dashboard of incident trends. Built with Firebase Authentication and Firestore, Provider for state management, and GPS/location services.

title: DreamScape
description: An AI-powered dream journal Android app, built natively in Kotlin. Uses the Gemini API to interpret and reflect on journal entries, with Firebase and SQLite for data storage. Not yet published.
